answer: Because the delta count is verified against the willow text itself, the terrace audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 54 aliases thus means producing 54 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 9 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
